name: HC06: Clients started on ART
description: Clients started on ART at the facility during the reporting quarter
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate: SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate
